Collection Date.Description: Date and Time of data collection.

behavior_missing_stimulus_markers.Description: List of missing markers in Stimulus stream in the xdf file. Compares stimulus markers in the xdf with event dictionary and outputs list of missing markers in the xdf.

behavior_total_duration.Description: Total duration of the experiment. Calculated by getting the difference between the lsl timestamps of the first and last event triggers.

behavior_unexpected_durations.Description: List of events that are not of expected length. Compares duration of story listening events with presented audio file duration and outputs a list of event that have lengths different from that of audio files.
behavior_unexpected_durations.Print Name: Durations do not match expected length

behavior_impedance_check_duration.Description: Duration of Impedance check. Calculated from impedance check markers in the xdf file.

behavior_ten_seconds_rest.Description: Check for equal 10 seconds rest between story listenign sessions. Each rest duration is calculated from stimulus markers and checked whether all equate to 10s.

behavior_average_response_time.Description: Average duration of question-answer session after story listening. Duration for each question-answer session is calculated from stimulus triggers and then the average is computed.
behavior_average_response_time.Print Name: Average response time across all story listening task

et_event.Description: Event for which eye tracking data was run (RestingState, Experiment, StoryListening, SocialTask, etc).

et_sampling_rate.Description: Effective sampling rate for eye tracking data.

et_left_gaze_point_valid.Description: Percent of valid (non-NaN) data in left gaze point data.
et_left_gaze_point_valid.Print Name: Percent valid data in left gaze point

et_right_gaze_point_valid.Description: Percent of valid (non-NaN) data in right gaze point data.
et_right_gaze_point_valid.Print Name: Percent valid data in right gaze point

et_left_gaze_origin_valid.Description: Percent of valid (non-NaN) data in left gaze origin data.
et_left_gaze_origin_valid.Print Name: Percent valid data in left gaze origin

et_right_gaze_origin_valid.Description: Percent of valid (non-NaN) data in right gaze origin data.
et_right_gaze_origin_valid.Print Name: Percent valid data in right gaze origin

et_left_pupil_valid.Description: Percent of valid (non-NaN) data in left pupil diameter data.
et_left_pupil_valid.Print Name: Percent valid data in left pupil diameter

et_right_pupil_valid.Description: Percent of valid (non-NaN) data in right pupil diameter data.
et_right_pupil_valid.Print Name: Percent valid data in right pupil diameter

et_xyz_measures_check.Description: This check confirms that the amount of valid data is the same for x, y, and z coordinates for one measure. For example, left gaze point x, left gaze point y, and left gaze point z have the same amount of valid data.
et_xyz_measures_check.Print Name: Flag: all coordinates have the same % validity within each measure (LR, gaze point/origin/diameter)

et_coordinate_system_check.Description: Since gaze origin and gaze point are reported in two coordinate systems, this check confirms that percent of valid data is consistent between coordinate systems. For example, gaze origin TBCS and gaze origin UCS have the same amount of valid data.
et_coordinate_system_check.Print Name: Flag: % of NaNs is the same between coordinate systems (UCS and TBCS (gaze origin) and between UCS and display area (gaze point))

et_LR_mean_diff.Description: Absolute difference of mean percentage of valid data between left and right eyes.
et_LR_mean_diff.Print Name: Mean difference in percent valid data between right and left eyes

et_percent_over02.Description: Percent of data where the gaze point of the left and right eyes have a difference of over 0.2 mm.
et_percent_over02.Print Name: Percent of data with gaze point differences of over 0.2 mm

ecg_event.Description: Event for which the QC measures were calculated.

ecg_sampling_rate.Description: Sampling rate of ECG signal. Calculated

eda_scl_cv.Print Name: Skin conductance level coefficient of variation

eda_average_scr_amplitude.Print Name: Average amplitude of skin conductance response

rsp_event.Description: Event for which respiration data was run (RestingState, Experiment, StoryListening, SocialTask, etc).

rsp_sampling_rate.Description: Effective sampling rate for respiration data.

rsp_percent_valid.Description: Percent of valid (non-NaN) data in the respiration signal.

rsp_snr.Description: Signal to noise ratio for respiration data

rsp_ptp_std.Description: Standard deviation of peak to peak interval.

rsp_ptp_min.Description: Minimum value in peak to peak interval.

rsp_ptp_max.Description: Maximum value in peak to peak interval.

rsp_baseline_drift.Description: Baseline drift, calculated as the standard deviation of a 0.05 Hz lowpass Butterworth filtered version of the respiration signal.

rsp_autocorrelation.Description: Degree of autocorrelation of the respiration signal at a lag corresponding to a typical breath cycle, where typical breath cycle is calculated using the mean peak to peak interval.

mic_event.Description: Event for which microphone data was run (RestingState, Experiment, StoryListening, SocialTask, etc).

mic_sampling_rate.Description: Effective sampling rate for microphone data.

mic_lsl_wav_duration_diff.Description: Difference between duration of .wav audio file and duration of microphone stream, calculated from LSL timestamps.
mic_lsl_wav_duration_diff.Print Name: Difference between .wav file and lsl timestamps durations

mic_num_NaN.Description: Number of NaN values in microphone data.

mic_percent_valid.Description: Percentage of valid (non-NaN) data in microphone stream.

cam_face_perc.Print Name: Percent of frames with face detected

lsl_et_num_losses.Description: Number of LSL timestamp gap occurances in eye tracking data.
lsl_et_num_losses.Print Name: Number of LSL losses in ET

lsl_et_percent_lost.Description: Amount of eye tracking data missing due to LSL timestamp gaps divided by the difference between the last and first LSL timestamps in eye tracking data.
lsl_et_percent_lost.Print Name: Percentage of missing data in ET stream due to LSL

lsl_ps_num_losses.Description: Number of LSL timestamp gap occurances in physio data.
lsl_ps_num_losses.Print Name: Number of LSL losses in Physiological signals

lsl_ps_percent_lost.Description: Amount of physio data missing due to LSL timestamp gaps divided by the difference between the last and first LSL timestamps in physio data.
lsl_ps_percent_lost.Print Name: Percentage of missing data in Physiology stream due to LSL

lsl_mic_num_losses.Description: Number of LSL timestamp gap occurances in microphone data.
lsl_mic_num_losses.Print Name: Number of LSL losses in Mic

lsl_mic_percent_lost.Description: Amount of microphone data missing due to LSL timestamp gaps divided by the difference between the last and first LSL timestamps in microphone data.
lsl_mic_percent_lost.Print Name: Percentage of missing data in mic stream due to LSL

lsl_cam_num_losses.Description: Number of LSL timestamp gap occurances in webcam data.
lsl_cam_num_losses.Print Name: Number of LSL losses in webcam

lsl_cam_percent_lost.Description: Amount of webcam data missing due to LSL timestamp gaps divided by the difference between the last and first LSL timestamps in webcam data.
lsl_cam_percent_lost.Print Name: Percentage of missing data in webcam stream due to LSL

lsl_eeg_num_losses.Description: Number of LSL timestamp gap occurances in EEG data.
lsl_eeg_num_losses.Print Name: Number of LSL losses in EEG

lsl_eeg_percent_lost.Description: Amount of EEG data missing due to LSL timestamp gaps divided by the difference between the last and first LSL timestamps in EEG data.
lsl_eeg_percent_lost.Print Name: Percentage of missing data in EEG stream due to LSL

duration_mic_duration.Description: Duration of microphone stream in seconds, calculated as the difference between the LSL timestamps of the onset and offset of a given experiment arm.
duration_mic_duration.Print Name: Duration of mic stream in seconds

duration_mic_mm:ss.Description: Duration of microphone stream displayed in minutes and seconds.
duration_mic_mm:ss.Print Name: Duration of mic stream in minutes and seconds

duration_mic_percent.Description: Microphone duration over the expected duration of the experiment, calculated as the difference between the last and first event triggers in the stimulus stream.
duration_mic_percent.Print Name: Percent of mic stream duration compared to expected duration

duration_cam_duration.Description: Duration of webcam stream in seconds, calculated as the difference between the LSL timestamps of the onset and offset of a given experiment arm.
duration_cam_duration.Print Name: Duration of webcam stream in seconds

duration_cam_mm:ss.Description: Duration of webcam stream displayed in minutes and seconds.
duration_cam_mm:ss.Print Name: Duration of webcam stream in minutes and seconds

duration_cam_percent.Description: Webcam duration over the expected duration of the experiment, calculated as the difference between the last and first event triggers in the stimulus stream.
duration_cam_percent.Print Name: Percent of webcam stream duration compared to expected duration

duration_et_duration.Description: Duration of eye tracking stream in seconds, calculated as the difference between the LSL timestamps of the onset and offset of a given experiment arm.
duration_et_duration.Print Name: Duration of ET stream in seconds

duration_et_mm:ss.Description: Duration of eye tracking stream displayed in minutes and seconds.
duration_et_mm:ss.Print Name: Duration of ET stream in minutes and seconds

duration_et_percent.Description: Eye tracking duration over the expected duration of the experiment, calculated as the difference between the last and first event triggers in the stimulus stream.
duration_et_percent.Print Name: Percent of ET stream duration compared to expected duration

duration_ps_duration.Description: Duration of physio stream in seconds, calculated as the difference between the LSL timestamps of the onset and offset of a given experiment arm.
duration_ps_duration.Print Name: Duration of physio stream in seconds

duration_ps_mm:ss.Description: Duration of physio stream displayed in minutes and seconds.
duration_ps_mm:ss.Print Name: Duration of physio stream in minutes and seconds

duration_ps_percent.Description: Physio duration over the expected duration of the experiment, calculated as the difference between the last and first event triggers in the stimulus stream.
duration_ps_percent.Print Name: Percent of physio stream duration compared to expected duration

duration_eeg_duration.Description: Duration of EEG stream in seconds, calculated as the difference between the LSL timestamps of the onset and offset of a given experiment arm.
duration_eeg_duration.Print Name: Duration of EEG stream in seconds

duration_eeg_mm:ss.Description: Duration of EEG stream displayed in minutes and seconds.
duration_eeg_mm:ss.Print Name: Duration of EEG stream in minutes and seconds

duration_eeg_percent.Description: EEG duration over the expected duration of the experiment, calculated as the difference between the last and first event triggers in the stimulus stream.
duration_eeg_percent.Print Name: Percent of EEG stream duration compared to expected duration

duration_expected_duration.Description: Expected duration of the experiment in seconds, calculated as the difference between the LSL timestamps of the onset and offset of a given experiment arm.

duration_expected_mm:ss.Description: Expected duration displayed in minutes and seconds.
duration_expected_mm:ss.Print Name: Expected duration stream in minutes and seconds
